purpose: Production assignment for the blog-to-reel-to-posting workflow

evidence.finding: LFM2.5 is fast and useful for bounded transformations but drifted from silver to vehicles in article and social copy. Gemma was slower and stronger on article structure, repair, metadata-adjacent tasks, chart decisions, and final QA.
evidence.qwen_status: Held out of production until its bounded runtime benchmark stops timing out.

assignments.release_gate: deterministic topic, source, length, placeholder, and financial accuracy QA
outline must match the topic contract
re-run full article QA after repair

assignments.reason: Fast and acceptable for constrained copy
assignments.release_gate: schema, topic token, length, and placeholder checks
deterministic query sanitization and media availability check

assignments.reason: More reliable structured output and final copy quality
assignments.release_gate: JSON schema, alt exactly 6 words, description 140-160 chars, no promotional language, topic coherence

assignments.owner: deterministic builders plus gemma3:4b-it-qat for repair
assignments.reason: The reel must remain traceable to the article and source artifacts
assignments.release_gate: parse, source, timing, paper-collage, chart, subtitle, and segment validation

assignments.reason: Best available final QA result in the rerun
assignments.release_gate: pass only when deterministic QA also passes and score is at least 85

assignments.reason: No model should control external publication
assignments.release_gate: hosted MP4 verification, create response, authoritative post readback, live URL and sitemap checks
